gloss: new school year; new academic year

definitions.gloss: new school year; new academic year
definitions.explanation: The beginning of a new academic year at a school. In Japan, the school year starts in April.

examples.japanese: {新学年|しんがくねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: The new school year has started.

examples.japanese: {新学年|しんがくねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧⟦{教科書|きょうかしょ}→教科書：01085_kyoukasho⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}する→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧。
examples.english: I'm preparing textbooks for the new school year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四月|しがつ}→四月：00668_shigatsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新学年|しんがくねん}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦クラス→クラス：01084_kurasu⟧になって、⟦{友達|ともだち}→友達：01478_tomodachi⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: Starting from the new school year in April, I was put in a new class, and my friends changed too.

notes:
In Japan, the academic year (⟦{学年|がくねん}→学年：00056_gakunen⟧) starts in April and ends in March, unlike many Western countries where it begins in September. The start of the {新学年|しんがくねん} coincides with cherry blossom season and is a significant cultural milestone.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新学年|しんがくねん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧: the new school year begins
- {新学年|しんがくねん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}けて→向ける：02306_mukeru⟧: in preparation for the new school year
- {新学年|しんがくねん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧: preparations for the new school year

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{新学期|しんがっき}→新学期：16070_shingakki⟧: new school term — refers to the start of a new term/semester within the year
- ⟦{入学式|にゅうがくしき}→入学式：05495_nyuugakushiki⟧: school entrance ceremony — held at the beginning of the school year for new students
- ⟦{始業式|しぎょうしき}→始業式：08555_shigyoushiki⟧: opening ceremony — marks the start of a new term for returning students
